initial.name: rich_inline_complete
initial.description: Settle a submitted Rich action once its outcome is known. Returns the settlement and structured values for the block.

actionId.description: Exact actionId from the submitted interactive input.

state.description: Use completed for confirmed success and failed for known failure.

values.description: Structured result values for the block.

initial.name: rich_inline_progress
initial.description: Report intermediate progress for a submitted Rich action that is still in progress.

actionId.description: Exact actionId from the submitted interactive input.

done.description: Units completed, from zero through total.

total.description: Total units of work, a non-negative integer.

label.description: Short description of work already performed.

initial.name: rich_inline_publish
initial.description: Replace the HTML, CSS, and JavaScript of an existing Rich block, including repairs requested by Render feedback. Returns the block ID and revisions. For a new block, emit a rich-html fenced result.

blockId.description: ID of the existing block in this session. Omission is supported for legacy tool callers creating a block.

expectedRenderRevision.description: Required for Render feedback repairs. Copy the renderRevision from that feedback.

fallbackText.description: Useful plain-text content if scripting or rendering is unavailable.

stateSchemaVersion.description: State schema version. Keep the existing version when repairing a block.

values.description: Replacement confirmed values. Omit to preserve the existing values.

initial.name: rich_inline_read
initial.description: Read one field of an immutable Rich block snapshot in this session. Returns a text fragment and nextOffset, or null at the end.

sourceRef.description: Exact reference from earlier Rich artifact context, including inherited references.

field.description: Snapshot field to read. Values are returned as JSON text.

offset.description: Zero-based UTF-16 offset. Use the returned nextOffset to continue.

length.description: Positive number of UTF-16 code units to read, subject to the per-call limit.

initial.name: rich_inline_update
initial.description: Replace the confirmed values and fallback text of an existing Rich block. Keeps the code and unsent inputs. Returns the new data revision.

blockId.description: ID of the existing block in this session.

expectedRenderRevision.description: Current render revision from the block publication or interactive input.

expectedDataRevision.description: Current data revision. Use the new revision returned by a successful update for the next write.

values.description: Complete replacement values, including entries that should remain.

fallbackText.description: Readable text representing the new confirmed state.
